premises.text: Depression care is blocked by stigma, distrust, wait lists, and trial-and-error prescribing without good biomarkers
premises.evidence_span: The big problem in mental health care is that there are no good biomarkers that exist today

premises.text: Circular RNA is stable and predictive enough to measure in blood for mental-health precision medicine
premises.evidence_span: It's a better way to help clinicians provide precision medicine leading to improved patient outcomes

premises.text: Company lab builds a molecular circRNA profile from blood to assess depression and likely medication response
premises.evidence_span: We can create a molecular profile of these circular RNAs and their expression changes, and we can run it through our analytical pipeline

premises.text: Primary care, telemedicine, and urgent care channels need faster depression diagnosis workflows
premises.evidence_span: All of these channels struggle with treating patients in a timely manner and have very difficult times working through the clinical diagnosis of depression

value.text: Bring precision medicine to mental health diagnostics and therapeutics
value.evidence_span: bring precision medicine to mental health diagnostics and therapeutics

secondary_value.text: Reduce clinic wait lists and improve patient experience in high-volume channels
secondary_value.evidence_span: improve their workflow, increase their volume, reduce those wait lists, and provide the patient a better experience
